profile.headline: Backend Software Engineer | Java, Spring Boot, PHP/Symfony | Building Scalable Systems for High-Volume Enterprise Applications
profile.summary:
Software Engineer who reduced invoice processing time by 30% and built a search feature spanning 10M+ records — after spending 8 years leading Army logistics teams responsible for $10M+ in equipment with zero accuracy loss.
 
That combination — military-grade discipline plus hands-on backend engineering — is what I bring to every team I join.
 
I specialize in backend and full-stack development (PHP/Symfony professionally, Java/Spring Boot through active personal projects), with deep experience in SQL optimization, database indexing, and diagnosing production performance issues — including using New Relic profiling to resolve N+1 query bottlenecks that were silently degrading system performance. I hold an Adobe Commerce Front-End Developer Professional certification and have led development on customer-facing e-commerce platforms, contributing across both frontend and backend.
 
I earned my B.S. in Computer Science from Middle Tennessee State University after transitioning out of the Army, and I tutored 100+ CS students in OOP, algorithms, and data structures along the way — so I care as much about writing maintainable, well-documented code as I do about shipping features.
 
Currently exploring backend/full-stack engineering roles at companies building serious enterprise-scale or fintech systems.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Architected a real-time transaction history search engine for 10M+ records, cutting VMI lookup time by 80% and materially improving customer satisfaction scores.
• Engineered a unified invoicing platform that consolidated manual, scanned, and automated workflows into a single pipeline, eliminating cross-channel ambiguity and streamlining UI/UX for internal stakeholders.
• Designed automated processing workflows with robust backend validation, cutting manual overhead by 30% and eliminating double-digit error rates.
• Owned a mission-critical ERP backend on Symfony supporting 10M+ product entries with near-zero downtime.
• Diagnosed and eliminated N+1 query bottlenecks using New Relic database profiling, resolving critical performance regressions in production.
• Drove frontend and backend development on a Magento-based e-commerce platform, applying Adobe Commerce best practices to improve checkout flow and scalability; Certified Adobe Commerce Front-End Developer Professional.
• Reduced data-entry errors across customer-facing forms by architecting client-side validation logic that caught malformed input before it reached the ERP backend.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Architected an event-driven IRC client using Qt's signal/slot framework to decouple UI and networking layers, enabling independent testing and reducing cross-component regressions.
• Led feature development across the application, producing maintainable, well-documented code adopted as the team's reference implementation.

positions.title: Computer Science Tutor
positions.description:
• Educated over 100 students on C++ software development assignments by analyzing, debugging, and testing the source code.
• Taught students Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), Algorithms, and Data Structures.

positions.title: Logistics Team Leader
positions.description:
• Trained and advised 10 supply personnel on logistical processes, property management, and requisition fulfillment.
• Maintained 100% database accuracy for $10M worth of military equipment, supplies, and vehicle parts using SAP application.
• Established task priorities, scheduled, and tracked work assignments, and ensured the availability of resources.

positions.title: Material Handler
positions.description:
• Played a vital role in providing knowledge and precision in impressive outcomes in warehouse installation with ratings at above 95%
• Turned in $2M worth of excess repair parts over 3,000 excess parts
• Deployed to Afghanistan for 9 months and conducted Sling Load Operations for the transportation of supplies

projects.title: RaiderTrade
projects.description: RaiderTrade is a marketplace website to buy and sell textbooks among students to save money. RaiderTrade is developed in Java with Spring Boot, Spring Security, Apache Maven, RESTful API, MVC Architecture, JPA, JSP, and MySQL.
